basic_info.chief_complaint: He complained of pain in his posterior teeth and came to our hospital for treatment.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: He complained of pain in his posterior teeth and came to our hospital for treatment.

oral_examination.oral_examination: *16,*14,*24 There are deep and large caries holes in the crown. When probing and percussing, the teeth are not loose. The teeth are sensitive and painful to cold stimulation. The gums are slightly red and swollen. CBCT showed deep caries penetrating the pulp and no obvious abnormality in the root apex. *18,*17,*15,*25,*26,*28,*36,*37,*38 There are black changes in the maxillary surface, rough and hard texture when detected, the probe is stuck, and the teeth are not loose when percussion. The gums are not red or swollen.

treatment_plan.definitive: *16,*14,*24Root canal treatment and crown restoration. *18,*28,*38 were removed. *17,*15,*25,*26,*36,*37 filling treatment.
treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient. The patient is informed and requests to go home to discuss with his family and postpone the treatment.
